messages:
Samir: FYI customer-reported p99 tail regression starting after last infra deploy. p95 looks fine but p99 for short prompts jumped from ~400ms -> ~2.1s. Happening across a handful of nodes in us-west-2. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/p99s

Jia: which service / model / traffic shape? short prompts vs long? any recent config changes rolled with that deploy?

Samir: service=continuous-batcher, model=rw-long-7b-qat (but affects other small-model routes too). Traffic is overwhelmingly short prompts (<10 tokens) from webhook flows. Deploy included autoscaler tweak (increase min_concurrency) + a batcher autotune change that bumped `hold_window_ms` from 6 -> 20 for certain pods.

Marta: that hold_window increase would definitely blow up p99 for short prompt workloads — waits longer to try to pack a batch, then lots of tiny late arrivals end up in small batches that pay extra scheduling overhead. Can you paste the batcher config we shipped?

Samir: pasted below (from prod pods):
```
continuous_batcher: 
  enabled: true
  hold_window_ms: 20
  min_batch_size: 1
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  aggressive_prefix_cache: false
```

Samir: repro script I used locally to mimic webhook load (1000 concurrent tiny requests):
```bash
for i in {1..1000}; do 
  curl -s -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"input":"hi"}' https://inference.redwood/api/v1/generate &
  sleep 0.005
done
```
Partial output shows most responses ~300-500ms but a tail at ~1.8-2.3s (every ~60-80 requests).

Jia: thanks. I'll attach a flamegraph and tracer capture — going to run a targeted canary with hold_window_ms=6 against same traffic. If p99 drops, this is config.

ops-bot: deploy 1732109600 started on continuous-batcher/canary with env override `HOLD_WINDOW_MS=6`

Marta: while Jia runs, two short mitigations we can do immediately: 1) enable `aggressive_prefix_cache=true` for short-prompt routes so KV/prefix hits avoid rework, 2) add a routing rule for requests with tokens<=10 to use `small-batch` variant (sync fallback) to avoid continuous batching entirely for that slice. Both can be toggled via console quickly.

Jia: canary results: before canary p99=2.1s, after canary p99=470ms, p95 unchanged. Looks like hold_window was the culprit. Trace shows extra wait time in batcher wait queue, not kernel.

Samir: good catch. Can we roll the hold_window change back globally? Also need a postmortem + alert to catch regressions when autotune flips this param again.

Marta: proposal: roll globally to 6ms for short-prompt lanes only; add an autotune guard that disallows hold_window_ms>10 when `short_prompt_route=true`. Add a regression alert: if p99>1s AND median <500ms trigger SEV-2.

Support-Bot: customer A (acct: acme-inc) notified of mitigation and asked if they'd like dedicated small-batch route while we stabilize.

Samir: rolling global change now for short-prompt label. Patch applied to 40 nodes. ops-bot report: 1732110202 config update success on continuous-batcher pool (HOLD_WINDOW_MS=6 for label=short-prompt).

ops-bot: rollout status: 40/40 nodes updated, no failures.

Jia: post-roll metrics after 15m: p99 back to ~480ms for short prompts, error rates unchanged. Canary traces show wait queue durations dropped from ~18ms -> ~4ms.

Marta: opened follow-ups: 
- Task ENG-4721: add autotune guard (owner: Jia)
- Task ENG-4722: add short-prompt routing + docs for DevEx (owner: Samir)
- Task ENG-4723: alert rule for p99/median divergence (owner: Marta)

Samir: quick notes for postmortem: root cause = autotune change that increased batcher hold_window to favor throughput, but for high-fanout short-prompt workloads that increases tail latency. Mitigation = rollback + targeted routing + prefix cache.

Marta: TL;DR for customers: temporary config change reduces tail; long-term we'll add safety checks to autotune and route high-fanout short prompts to a different handling path.

Samir: thanks all. If we see any residual anomalies @here. :thumbsup:

Jia: adding logs/commands that helped debug in case someone needs to repro later:
```
# gather traces for a window
kubectl logs -l app=continuous-batcher -n infra --since=5m | grep trace_id=17321 | less
# fetch config from a node
kubectl exec -it pod/continuous-batcher-aaa -n infra -- cat /etc/continuous-batcher/config.yaml
```

Marta: closing thread once follow-ups are triaged. Marking SEV mitigated. :white_check_mark:
